objective: Characterize the Film Damage Gate Weave RGB resampling and source-alpha restoration at a synthetic transparent edge, including direction/amount of fixed subpixel and integer shifts, composited edge leakage, detail response, and resolution scaling.

scope.effect: FilmDamageCPUImpl::cv::warpAffine branch only, with grain/dust/scratches/flicker/filmBurn neutralized.
scope.method: Offline OpenCV model using fixed displacement vectors chosen independently of std::mt19937. The model reproduces the source affine matrix, INTER_LINEAR and BORDER_REFLECT101 behavior, then restores the original alpha plane as the source loop does.

comparison.baseline: Same alpha/color fixture with no displacement and matching alpha association; no weave is the arithmetic baseline, not a quality target.
candidates: straight-alpha input/output composited with the straight equation.
premultiplied-alpha input/output composited with the premultiplied equation.
comparison.ground_truth: No external ground truth. Effect-off paired fixture separates model response; it does not define acceptable weave.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive response only, no visual threshold or defect declaration. Report differences by direction, alpha region, association assumption, and resolution.

materials.fixture: Synthetic 512x256 and 1024x512 translucent ellipse with saturated interior patches, smooth alpha boundary, high-contrast lines/checker and transparent zero RGB exterior. Premultiplied variant multiplies logical RGB by alpha.
materials.rights: Generated locally by the study script.
materials.identity: Record hashes of source, plan, script, fixture arrays, metrics, and generated PNGs.

conditions.format: Float32 BGRA storage, logical RGB values in [0,1], direct numeric domain with no transfer conversion. Alpha edge itself is float32.
conditions.warp: OpenCV INTER_LINEAR, BORDER_REFLECT101; source matrix [[1,0,dx],[0,1,dy]]; output RGB(A) warp is followed by replacing alpha with the source alpha plane, matching the source loop's alpha write.
conditions.displacements: Fixed signed pixel offsets listed in comparison; default Gate Weave is 1.5. Offsets are diagnostic test inputs, not recovered random draws.
conditions.association: Straight source-over = RGB*alpha+bg*(1-alpha); premultiplied source-over = storedRGB+bg*(1-alpha). Each branch preserves the corresponding input representation when constructing the fixture.
metrics: per-region RGB paired MAE/RMSE/p95/max after compositing over black/gray/white
transparent RGB leakage and premultiplied RGB>alpha bounds
same normalized displacement relation across resolutions
conditions.display: Diagnostic direct-clipped RGB8 PNGs and same-scale contact sheets; raw float arrays/statistics are authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Verify source markers for affine shift, interpolation/border mode, working RGBA warp and restoration of original source alpha; test zero-shift identity and finite results.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Zero shift matches bounded input within OpenCV float tolerance; alpha remains exact; no compiled parity claim.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect alpha-edge and detail ROIs at 1:1 and enlarged view over multiple backgrounds; report edge color/coverage and interpolation softness.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic pass/fail; document locations and pixel metrics.

color_and_alpha.method: Track original alpha separately from warped RGB under straight and premultiplied source-over assumptions.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Actual layer descriptor at each product entry point, exact OpenCV version/compiler path and rendered output.

temporal_stability.reason: This study isolates the spatial response for given offsets; frameKey/seed scheduling is separately modeled, but random frame sequence is not rendered.

render_paths_and_resolution.method: Run the CPU warp equation at two dimensions with the same pixel offsets and a doubled offset normalized-size pair.
render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Application path, preview/final, GPU route, and actual frame-size/LOD mapping.

performance.reason: No product timing or memory profiling.

execution.backend: Python 3, NumPy, OpenCV, Pillow; local synthetic fixtures only.
execution.threshold_policy: Descriptive only; no tolerance for perceptual acceptance is invented.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed patch colors, alpha formula, displacement vectors and library versions; store plan/source/script/PNG/metrics hashes and checksum.
